end.summary:
Practised representing numbers 11–20 as one bundle of ten and loose ones.
Saanvi made 4 attempts, with 2 correct without help.
They identified loose ones as sticks outside the bundle in some turns.
They sometimes counted the bundle as 1 when finding the total; this mix-up remained in the final seen example.
Teach-back was not passed.
end.parentNote: Asha practised matching a bundle of ten and loose sticks to numbers such as fourteen and thirteen. Saanvi used the helpful method of naming the loose sticks and connected one bundle plus three sticks with thirteen, but they still sometimes counted the bundle as only one when finding how many sticks there were altogether. At home, show one group of ten objects with 1–9 extra objects and ask, “How many altogether?” while saying “ten and some more.”
